text:
maya: Heads up — we plan a regional cutover for eu-west-3 TOMORROW 2024-11-03 02:00 UTC. This is a capacity/routing swap and we'll pin the inference runtime to v1.4.2 for the rollout. Expect brief intermittent latency or short failures for a small subset of requests. @support-ops please prep customer messaging.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout created by maya: deploy id dpl-88123. Start: 2024-11-03T02:00Z. Targets: eu-west-3 (primary), fallback eu-west-1. Pinned runtime: v1.4.2. Model variant: gptx-6b-q4. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cutover-eu-west

sam: Noted, I'll be on pager for the window and watching SLOs (errors + latency).

eli: Quick Q — is there any DB migration or config change that needs infra coordination?

maya: No DB migration. Purely routing + capacity swap + runtime pin. Infra/Netops looped in. Priya will handle statuspage + customer comms.

priya: Drafted statuspage snippet below — please review: 
```
Status: Degraded — We are performing a scheduled cutover in the EU region (eu-west-3) which may cause intermittent latency or short failures for a small percentage of requests between 02:00–02:30 UTC. We will provide updates here as progress is made.
```

sam: LGTM. Suggest adding "no customer data migration" for clarity.

priya: Updated snippet: 
```
Status: Degraded — We are performing a scheduled cutover in the EU region (eu-west-3) which may cause intermittent latency or short failures for a small percentage of requests between 02:00–02:30 UTC. No customer data migration is involved. Services will continue to retry automatically.
```

support-ops: Can you also provide the small email/console blurbs? We need 1-line, 3-line, and full message for console + email.

maya: 1-line: "Scheduled EU regional cutover — brief intermittent latency expected (02:00–02:30 UTC)."

maya: 3-line (console): "Scheduled EU regional cutover at 02:00 UTC. Intermittent latency possible for some requests. No data migration; rollback plan in place."

maya: Full email (subject + body):
Subject: Planned maintenance: EU regional cutover (02:00 UTC)
Body: We will perform a scheduled cutover to new EU capacity (eu-west-3) on 2024-11-03 at 02:00 UTC. During the window, some requests may see increased latency or short failures. No customer data will be migrated or modified. We will post updates on https://status.redwood.ai/ and via email. If you have strict HA requirements, contact support@redwood.ai before the window.

eli: Rollback criteria? Who triggers rollback?

sam: Rollback if: >1% 5-min error rate OR sustained p95 latency >1.5s for >10 minutes. Trigger authority: sam or maya. Escalation: oncall + eng-sre.

deploy-bot: dpl-88123: canary start ok — 3/3 canaries passed. Proceeding to gradual ramp.

deploy-bot: dpl-88123: ramp 40% complete. Observed small bump in p95 latency in eu-west-1, still within thresholds.

maya: If we see error spike, we will pin callers to fallback region and roll back. @support-ops prepare canned regional messages (FR/DE/NL).

support-ops: Acknowledged — prepping localized messages and short Q&A for customers. Will have drafts by 01:30 UTC.

priya: Statuspage update queued, ETA publish 01:50 UTC. Email blast scheduled 01:55 UTC to affected account owners.

maya: I'll be on #eng-oncall during the window and will post live updates here. Flagging this thread for postmortem notes (include reason for pin).

sam: Action item: include reasoning in release notes: "Pinned runtime v1.4.2 to avoid regressions introduced by experimental kernel scheduler in v1.5.0 — prevents model regressions during cutover." I'll add a short line to the release notes after the window.

statusbot: Incident created — INC-20241103-42. Status: investigating. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/INC-20241103-42

priya: Closing loop — statuspage live, email blast queued. Will post final closure note once all checks pass or after rollback ends.

maya: Thanks team. Keep replies minimal during the window unless critical.
